notes: Every standard answer is byte-identical to its independently retained reference.txt file.
Existing reference-correction receipts are accepted only when they bind the old independent reference hash to the current reference hash and declare that provider output was not used.
The declared selector or target-scope description remains attached to every case; provider output was not inspected while rebuilding regions.

segmentation.policy: Tables, grids, forms, iframe lists, generated operation catalogues, and other indivisible declared components remain whole. Prose without preserved heading or paragraph boundaries is grouped only at complete sentence boundaries.
